Inland Revenue Act, No. 10 of 2006 135: Where two or more persons act in the capacity of

column1: trustees of a trust not being any unit trust, or executors of a
deceased  person’s  estate,  they  may  be  charged  jointly  or
severally with the income tax with which they are chargeable
in  that  capacity  under  this Act,  and  shall  be  jointly  and
severally liable for payment of such taxes.
